Who we are:

Join BAE Systems and you'll be part of something bigger. As a valued member of our global colleague network, you'll bring your unique skills and perspectives to help pioneer progress and protect what matters most. You'll be trusted to play your part in delivering the advanced, technology-led defence, aerospace and security solutions of tomorrow - shaping a safer future, for all of us.

From the depths of the ocean, to the far reaches of space - there's no limit to where a career at BAE Systems could take you.

Role Description:

We have exciting opportunities for 1st Class CNC Machinists to join our Battlespace Integrated Solutions Business Unit based at Edinburgh Parks, South Australia.

Advanced Manufacturing has won multiple large long-term contracts. We are seeking experienced 1st Class CNC Machinist for multiple positions who are capable across multiple CNC machine types, manual machining, and with fitting experience to join our day, afternoon and night shift teams. As the 1st CNC Class Machinist, you will receive four weeks' annual leave, access to overtime, RDOs, uniform, access to on site canteen, all in the comfort of a temperature controlled working environment. Shares after one year of service.

Core Duties:

  • Be responsible for computer numerical control (CNC) machining tasks associated with defence requirements
  • Undertake CNC component machining who is flexible across a range of CNC machines on various defence projects to meet scheduled requirements.
  • Ensure that all appropriate documentation for engineering systems and defect reporting are incorporated for traceability
  • Liaise with BAE Systems' Quality staff to ensure compliance with project quality requirements
  • Comply with BAE Systems Safety, Health and Environment procedures with the requirements of the BAE Systems' Quality systems as they relate to respective areas of activity
  • Alert the organisation to potential or known problems that affect the quality of BAE Systems' products and services
  • Provide input and offering recommendations for the improvement of company processes and procedures
  • Validate parts as they are manufactured


About YOU:

  • A Mechanical trade certificate
  • CNC machining experience
  • Manual Machining and Fitting experience (preferred)
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a defence security clearance of âBaselineâ and be cleared for International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR)
  • A strong team focus and a can do attitude
  • The ability to communicate effectively with all stakeholders
  • The availability to work from 7.00am until 3.30pm Monday-Friday (day shift)
  • The availability to work from 3.00pm until 12.00am Monday-Friday
  • The availability to work from 12.00pm until 8.00am Sunday-Thursday (night shift)


Why BAE Systems?

Here you'll build a career with purpose and limitless possibilities. With lifelong learning and meaningful work - this is a place where you can grow your career with confidence and be empowered to be your best. title: (Senior) Product Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übersetzt Strategie in Features: Du identifizierst Nutzerprobleme, bewertest Markt- und Wettbewerbstrends und entwickelst aus groben Zielen und Produktvisionen konkrete Features – mit einem Gespür dafür, was besonders mobile Produkte auszeichnet.

  • Du schreibst Anforderungen, die tragen: Du bereitest Themen so auf, dass Designer und Entwickler direkt loslegen können – nicht erst nachfragen müssen.

  • Du denkst User Journeys, nicht nur User Stories: Du skizzierst Konzepte, verwirfst Ideen, entwickelst sie weiter – und findest den besten Weg für unsere Nutzer:innen.

  • Du coachst und befähigst: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Managern zusammen, gibst fachliches Feedback und hilfst ihnen, in ihrer Rolle zu wachsen.

  • Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle: Im engen Austausch mit Projektleitung, UX, Entwicklung, Sales und weiteren Stakeholdern sorgst du dafür, dass aus Ideen echte Features werden – termingerecht und in hoher Qualität.

  • Du machst Erfolg messbar: Gemeinsam mit den Teams definierst du Erfolgskennzahlen, leitest daraus Prioritäten ab und misst den Erfolg neuer Produktinitiativen.


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement – idealerweise mit digitalen Produkten, die eine hohe Komplexität und Reichweite haben, und bringst Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Produkte mit.

  • Du hast Strategie in Features übersetzt – nicht nur verwaltet, sondern aktiv gestaltet. Du kannst zeigen, welche Produkte du konzeptionell vorangebracht und von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleitet hast.

  • Du verstehst, was mobile Produkte anders macht als Web – du musst kein App-Store-Experte sein, aber du kennst die Unterschiede in UX, Architektur und Nutzerverhalten.

  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Produktstrategie, Priorisierung und Stakeholder-Kommunikation mit und kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen übersetzen.

  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte KI-Affinität mit und nutzt KI-Tools souverän, um Produktideen zu schärfen, Anforderungen zu strukturieren, Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und datenbasierte Entscheidungen vorzubereiten.

  • Du schreibst Anforderungen mit Substanz – klar, vollständig, priorisiert. Deine User Stories sind keine Platzhalter, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und kreativ zugleich: Du hast Methoden für Ideenfindung und Konzeption – und die Disziplin, Ergebnisse festzuhalten.

  • Du kannst fachlich coachen, ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du gibst Feedback, das Kolleg:innen weiterbringt.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1-Niveau). Außerdem kannst du sicher auf Englisch kommunizieren.

  • Du lässt dich vom fußballbegeisterten Spirit deiner Teammitglieder anstecken und bringst idealerweise selbst deine Leidenschaft für Fußball mit ein.

Da sich unser Büro in Hamburg befindet, ist die Stelle vorzugsweise an unserem Standort in Hamburg zu besetzen. Gleichzeitig bieten wir die Möglichkeit, flexibel im hybriden Modell zu arbeiten.


Deine Vorteile bei uns

  • Begeisterung für Fußball: Unser internationales Team teilt eine leidenschaftliche Liebe zum Fußball – du hast die Möglichkeit, dieses hautnah im Stadion zu erleben, indem du von VIP- und Dauerkarten profitierst.

  • Spielraum für Innovation: Entfalte neue Ideen und nutze Formate wie Brownbags und Reviews, um kontinuierlich unsere Weiterentwicklung voranzutreiben.

  • Flexibilität: Profitiere von mobiler Arbeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Workation-Möglichkeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

  • Teamzusammenhalt: Regelmäßige "Get-Together" und Team-Events stärken unseren Teamgeist. Von unterhaltsamen Fußballquizzen bis hin zu anderen sportlichen Aktivitäten und unseren festlichen Weihnachtsfeiern.

  • Entwicklungschancen: Wir unterstützen deine Weiterbildung durch Seminare, Weiterbildungen und die Teilnahme an Konferenzen zur Vernetzung. Unsere wöchentlichen internen Englischkurse tragen nicht nur zur Verbesserung deiner Sprachkenntnisse bei, sondern stärken auch die Vernetzung innerhalb Transfermarkt.

  • Mobilität: Nutze die Möglichkeit, das Deutschlandticket vergünstigt zu erwerben, um flexibel und kostengünstig zu reisen.

  • Zukunftssicherung: Wir fördern deine finanzielle Absicherung mit Zuschüssen zur VWL und betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

  • Wohlfühlatmosphäre im Büro: Wir stellen Getränke, Obst und Snacks für dich bereit. Zwischendurch hast du die Möglichkeit, bei einer Runde FIFA oder beim Kickern mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen abzuschalten.


Das klingt wie für dich gemacht?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über das Bewerbungsformular!

Dann melde dich gerne per Mail an ----- bei Leah Seidel-Whitelaw.

title: Director of Talent Acquisition (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Location: Role is Hybrid and based in either Berlin or Darmstadt, Germany, with remote flexibility.

Your Role

We're hiring a Director of Talent Acquisition to own how this company hires. This isn't a caretaker role over a recruiting queue. You'll lead our Talent Acquisition and Employer Branding function — a team of five TA Partners and a TA Enablement & Analytics Partner — and build the operating model that makes hiring a genuine competitive advantage.

You're joining at a pivotal moment. The TA function is operational and delivering, but quality, consistency, and hiring manager capability haven't yet caught up with our ambitions. Our ability to scale from Series A through commercialization depends on hiring the right people, at the right pace, into the right roles — across fusion science, laser engineering, software, operations, and G&A. You won't inherit a finished machine. You'll build one.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership Lead and develop five TA Partners and the TA Enablement & Analytics Partner — setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a high-performing team culture that delivers without you in every decision.

Hiring Standards and Rigour Build and maintain the TA operating standards: hiring processes, interview frameworks, scorecards, and decision criteria applied consistently across every function. Raise the bar on quality, not just throughput.

Capacity Planning Drive capacity planning in close partnership with Finance and department heads, ensuring TA is resourced and sequenced ahead of demand — never the bottleneck to a planned hire.

Hiring Manager Enablement Equip leaders to run structured, fair hiring processes through training, coaching, and tooling — reducing dependency on TA for process guidance and raising the quality of hiring decisions.

ATS and Data Own the ATS end to end: configuration, data integrity, adoption, and continuous improvement. Use pipeline data and KPIs to identify bottlenecks, drive process changes, and report progress that drives decisions rather than decorates them.

Employer Branding Build a consistent, differentiated presence in our target talent markets — LinkedIn, Glassdoor, job boards, events, and content — in partnership with Marketing, so inbound quality improves quarter on quarter.

Who You Are

• 10+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, with meaningful time leading and developing recruiting teams

• Experience in a scaling tech, deep-tech, or engineering-heavy environment, hiring for specialised, hard-to-fill roles

• Fluent with AI in your daily recruiting work — sourcing, screening, content, analytics — and able to raise your team's bar on it

• A KPI-driven operator: structured interviewing, assessment design, capacity planning, and hiring manager enablement are core methods, not buzzwords

• Hands-on ATS ownership: configuration, vendor management, reporting, and driving adoption across recruiters and hiring managers

• Strong working knowledge of GDPR as it applies to candidate data, and of German employment law in hiring

• Fluent in English; German is a meaningful plus

What Sets You Apart

• You've built or significantly rebuilt a TA operating model — standards, processes, and team structure — in a company that doubled headcount

• You've made employer branding work in a competitive talent market, with results you can point to

• You have a point of view on what great talent acquisition looks like — and it's grounded in outcomes, not activity

• You're drawn to mission-driven companies and want your work to connect to something larger than the next quarter

Why This Role

• Own the function that most directly gates the growth of one of the most ambitious clean energy ventures in the world

• Build the hiring engine that carries a science-driven company from Series A through commercialization

• A leadership team that treats People as a strategic function, not a support desk

• Competitive compensation, equity participation, and benefits reflective of the talent bar we hold

What We Offer

• Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

• Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

• Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

• Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

• Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

• Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

• Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

• Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

• Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

• Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs — whether it's a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing, you choose what fits your lifestyle.

• Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d) Go-to-Market-Strategie
description:
Baue als Marketing Manager die Marke hinter einer Technologie auf, die unsere Straßen in Kraftwerke verwandelt und bringe sie in neue Märkte. 💡

Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsendes GreenTech Startup aus Mils, das eines der weltweit ersten skalierbaren Straßenkraftwerke entwickelt. Durch die Integration innovativer Energierückgewinnungstechnologie in bestehende Straßen entsteht eine völlig neue Form der erneuerbaren Energiegewinnung, ganz ohne zusätzliche Flächenversiegelung.

Als Marketing & Communications Manager gestaltest du den Marketingbereich von Grund auf mit und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer außergewöhnlichen Technologie eine international sichtbare Marke wird. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Strategie und Kommunikation: Du entwickelst konkrete Go to Market Maßnahmen, setzt eigene Ideen direkt um und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Business Development und der Geschäftsführung daran, unterschiedliche Märkte erfolgreich anzusprechen.

Gesucht wird jemand, der gerne anders denkt, neue Wege ausprobiert und keine Scheu davor hat, auch ungewöhnliche Marketingideen in die Realität umzusetzen. Wenn du Strategie und Hands on Umsetzung verbinden möchtest und Lust darauf hast, Marketing in einem GreenTech Startup langfristig mit aufzubauen, findest du hier jede Menge Gestaltungsspielraum.

Aufgaben

Als Marketing Manager entwickelst du Marketingmaßnahmen für eine außergewöhnliche GreenTech Innovation und sorgst gemeinsam mit Sales und Business Development dafür, dass die Technologie in unterschiedlichen Märkten die richtigen Zielgruppen erreicht.

  • Marketingstrategie: Entwickle den Marketingbereich strategisch weiter und übersetze Unternehmensziele in konkrete Maßnahmen und Kampagnen.
  • Go to Market: Entwickle gezielte Marketingmaßnahmen für bestehende und neue Märkte und unterstütze damit aktiv die internationale Marktbearbeitung.
  • Sales Support: Arbeite eng mit Sales und Business Development zusammen und entwickle Inhalte, Kampagnen und Maßnahmen, die den Vertrieb in unterschiedlichen Märkten wirkungsvoll unterstützen.
  • Kreative Umsetzung: Entwickle neue Marketingideen, teste auch ungewöhnliche Ansätze und bringe erfolgreiche Konzepte schnell und eigenständig in die Umsetzung.
  • Storytelling: Übersetze komplexe technische Themen in verständliche, überzeugende und visuell starke Inhalte für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen.
  • Markenentwicklung: Entwickle Markenidentität, Positionierung und visuellen Auftritt kontinuierlich weiter und schaffe einen konsistenten internationalen Markenauftritt.
  • Kommunikation & PR: Entwickle relevante externe Kommunikation und koordiniere unter anderem Pressemitteilungen, Statements, Eventkommunikation und Medienunterlagen.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im B2B Marketing, Brand Building, Kommunikation, PR oder Kampagnenmanagement.Erfahrung darin, Marketingstrategien nicht nur zu entwickeln, sondern konkrete Maßnahmen selbstständig umzusetzen.
  • Verständnis für Go to Market Strategien und dafür, wie Marketing Sales und Business Development bei der Erschließung unterschiedlicher Märkte unterstützen kann.
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen verständlich, überzeugend und zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau für eine reibungslose Kommunikation.
  • Kreative Persönlichkeit mit Mut zu unkonventionellen Ideen, Eigeninitiative und Freude daran, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren.
  • Ausgeprägte Hands on Mentalität und Begeisterung dafür, in einem dynamischen Startup Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Strukturen mit aufzubauen.
  • Idealerweise kannst du bereits Beispiele für ungewöhnliche oder besonders kreative Marketingmaßnahmen vorweisen, die du erfolgreich entwickelt und umgesetzt hast.
  • Erfahrung aus einer Marketing- oder Kommunikationsagentur, Kenntnisse in Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator oder Figma sowie Interesse an GreenTech und nachhaltigen Technologien sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • Impact: Baue die Marken- und Kommunikationsstrategie eines der innovativsten GreenTech Startups Europas aktiv mit auf.
  • Verantwortung: Übernimm von Beginn an die strategische Verantwortung für Marketing, Kommunikation und Markenauftritt.
  • Karriere: Wachse gemeinsam mit einem schnell wachsenden ClimateTech Startup und entwickle deinen Verantwortungsbereich mit dem Unternehmen weiter.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit Geschäftsführung, Business Development und Sales zusammen und gestalte die Unternehmensstrategie aktiv mit.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Profitiere von Mentoring durch erfahrene Unternehmer sowie kontinuierlichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Bonus & Beteiligung: Leistungsabhängige Bonuszahlungen sowie die Möglichkeit, dir Unternehmensanteile durch außergewöhnliches Engagement zu erarbeiten.
  • Arbeitsumfeld: Modernes Büro, neueste Technik, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks, Küche sowie großzügige Sozialbereiche.
  • Mobilität: Bike Leasing, organisierte Fahrgemeinschaft zwischen Innsbruck und Mils sowie Firmenparkplatz.
  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 45.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform with its own owned and operated global mobile core network in 15 countries, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses; 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 43 countries worldwide.


The company serves many of the world’s leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 80 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.


1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in 1GLOBAL’s journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating its evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.


Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 15 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets.   • Good understanding of cloud services and scalable infrastructure;
  • Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with a self-motivated and autonomous mindset.

title: Working Student Risk (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. By empowering FinTechs, Banks and Wealth Managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets provides a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform for simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.

We have experienced first-hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that, we make investing seamlessly accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional people like you.

Your mission:

We are looking for a Working Student in Risk (f/m/x) to help us with our daily risk management tasks. This includes topics like operational and financial/ non‑financial risks, internal controls, and audit support. You will collect and organise information, analyse data, and support us in making our processes more automated and efficient.

In this role, you get real hands‑on experience in how risk management works inside a regulated fintech. You’ll support both small projects and everyday tasks to help keep our risk management and audit processes running smoothly.

You will work closely with the Risk team, and cross-functional with Tech, Product, Operations, Finance and Compliance. This gives you the chance to learn from experienced colleagues, take ownership of tasks, and make an impact from day one in a fast‑paced, modern work environment.

In this role you will:

  • You will not only support the Risk team on various day-to-day operational tasks & projects within Risk, Audit and associated teams, but also develop processes further within the various back office functions by questioning existing processes and not shying away from breaking new ground, advocating for digitalisation & efficiency where possible.

  • Support general risk management activities across multiple risk categories (e.g. Credit, Market, Liquidity, Operational Risk)

  • Assist in identifying, assessing, and documenting risk-related matters (among other counterparty, market risk, as well as IT and third-party assessments)

  • Contribute to maintaining and improving risk registers, controls, and process documentation

  • Support internal audit and follow‑up activities

  • Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis to support risk assessments

  • Gather risk‑related data and transform it into clear, structured insights

  • Assist in incident reviews, root‑cause analysis, and remediation tracking

  • Work cross‑functionally with engineering, product, and operations teams, as well as other back-office and control functions


You will be successful in this role if:

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in economics, business administration or a quantitative or tech‑related field

  • You enjoy working with data, numbers, structures, and analytical problems

  • You are curious about risk management beyond a single domain

  • You are eager to learn how risk processes work in modern fintech infrastructure

  • You communicate clearly and document precisely

  • You are proactive, reliable, and detail‑oriented

  • You enjoy using or learning to work with tools like Atlassian and Google Suite, SQL, Python, and different AI LLMs (BI, SQL, Python or similar is a plus)

  • You are fluent in written and spoken German and English

  • You are based in Berlin

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: Our working student positions are compensated at a fixed rate of €15-17 per hour.

  • 💎 Make a real impact: Our start-up environment gives you the room to start your career, explore areas outside your role, and build expertise through ownership. As we mature and are backed by dwpbank, we’re adding a layer of resources and expertise you are benefiting from.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We know your studies come first. That’s why we offer flexible hours that adapt to your class schedule and exam periods, so you can plan your work time around your semester.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from Berlin within a hybrid model. That being said, we encourage our working student lemoneers to come to the office regularly. Being on-site allows you to learn faster, provides a more immersive experience, helps you collaborate more effectively with the team, and ensures you fully benefit from hands-on support.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, plus a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations so you always know where you stand, and what to do to level up.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

title: Werkstudent IT-Administration & Security (m/w/d)
description:
Intro

Auf einen Blick

  • Rolle: Werkstudent IT-Administration & Security / Werkstudent IT Support (m/w/d)

  • Unternehmen: Vivira, Digital Health, Anbieter der ersten dauerhaft gelisteten DiGA Deutschlands

  • Standort: Berlin-Mitte (Mindspace Stadtmitte), hybrid

  • Stunden: 20 Stunden/Woche im Semester, flexibel rund um Deine Vorlesungen und Prüfungen

  • Start: Ab sofort

  • Vergütung: 16–20 €/Stunde, je nach Erfahrung

  • Sprachen: Englisch fließend, Deutsch mindestens B1

  • Voraussetzung: Immatrikulierte/r Student/in

  • Perspektive: Echte Verantwortung, Mentoring und ein realistischer Weg in eine Festanstellung nach dem Abschluss


Hilf mit, das IT-Rückgrat eines der führenden Digital-Health-Unternehmen Deutschlands aufzubauen.


Bei Vivira machst Du weit mehr, als Passwörter zurückzusetzen oder Laptops einzurichten. Als Werkstudent im Bereich IT & Security sorgst Du mit dafür, dass ein schnell wachsendes Digital-Health-Unternehmen in Berlin jeden Tag reibungslos läuft: vom Onboarding neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen über die Verwaltung moderner SaaS-Anwendungen bis zur Unterstützung unserer Security-Infrastruktur.


Du arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einer modernen, cloudbasierten Umgebung und trägst zu einer Technologie bei, die Tausenden von Patientinnen und Patienten hilft, ihre Rückenschmerzen in den Griff zu bekommen, mit Deutschlands erster dauerhaft erstattungsfähiger Digitaler Gesundheitsanwendung (DiGA).


Wenn Du Informatik (oder ein verwandtes Fach) studierst und echte Praxiserfahrung in IT & Security sammeln willst statt nur eines Praktikumstitels, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen

  • IT-Helpdesk & Technischer Support: Du unterstützt den Vivira IT-Helpdesk und leistest remote sowie vor Ort First-Level-Support bei Software, Tools und allgemeinem Troubleshooting.

  • Infrastruktur vor Ort: Manche Aufgaben lassen sich remote erledigen, regelmäßig bist Du aber in unserem Office im Mindspace Stadtmitte, um bei IT-Hardware und Security-Infrastruktur tatkräftig anzupacken.

  • On- & Offboarding: Du unterstützt das IT-On- und Offboarding, von der physischen Einrichtung des Offices über die Vorbereitung der Hardware für neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen bis zur Rücknahme bei ausscheidenden.

  • SaaS-Administration: Du hilfst bei der Verwaltung verschiedener SaaS-Anwendungen, Benutzerkonten und Zugriffsrechte.

  • Hardware-Wartung: Du kümmerst Dich mit um Reparaturen und Austausch von Geräten, damit unser Team immer gut ausgestattet ist.

  • Netzwerk-Infrastruktur: Du unterstützt das Monitoring unserer Netzwerk-Infrastruktur, inklusive Firewalls, Routern und VPN-Lösungen.

  • Dokumentation: Du hilfst dabei, Systemkonfigurationen, Richtlinien und Prozesse aktuell zu halten.

  • IT-Security: Du unterstützt Security-Initiativen wie Access Management, Endpoint Security, MFA und Device Compliance.


Das lernst Du bei uns

Praxiserfahrung, über die die meisten Studierenden nur in Vorlesungen lesen:

  • Moderne Apple-/macOS-Administration & Endpoint Management (MDM)

  • Cloudbasierte IT-Infrastruktur und SaaS-Administration

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) und Grundlagen der IT-Security

  • Device Lifecycle Management

  • IT-Betrieb in einem regulierten Digital-Health-Umfeld

  • Support für verteilte, remote-first arbeitende Teams

Du arbeitest mit einem modernen, cloud-first Toolset, darunter MDM für unsere Apple-Flotte, Single Sign-on und IAM, eine führende Productivity Suite sowie aktuelle Endpoint-Security- und Netzwerk-Lösungen. Den kompletten Stack stellen wir Dir im ersten Gespräch vor.


Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Du bist aktuell in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem anderen technischen Studiengang an einer Hochschule in Berlin oder Umgebung immatrikuliert.

  • Du kannst regelmäßig aus unserem Office im Mindspace Stadtmitte arbeiten, mitten im Zentrum von Berlin.

  • Du hast ein solides Verständnis von macOS und Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen.

  • Du interessierst Dich für IT-Administration, Infrastruktur und Informationssicherheit.

  • Du hilfst gerne und kommunizierst freundlich und serviceorientiert.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und proaktiv.

  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch und hast mindestens Deutschkenntnisse auf B1-Niveau, da Du regelmäßig Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort unterstützt.

  • Erste Erfahrung durch eigene Projekte, Praktika oder Studentenjobs (Werkstudent, HiWi, IT-Support) ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.


Das erwartet Dich bei Vivira

  • Vergütung: 16–20 € pro Stunde, je nach Erfahrung, für eine 20-Stunden-Werkstudentenstelle, die sich an Dein Studium anpasst.

  • Flexibilität: Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach Deinem Vorlesungsplan und Deinen Prüfungsphasen richten.

  • Arbeitsplatz: Arbeite von Zuhause oder aus unserem Berliner HQ in zentraler Lage (Mindspace Stadtmitte), mit hochwertiger Apple-Hardware.

  • Recharge: Bezahlte Urlaubstage für echte Pausen und neue Energie.

  • Gesundheit: Beweglichkeit und Rückenpower direkt von uns für Dich, mit digitaler Unterstützung, die Du selbst nutzen kannst.

  • Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Vorteilen für Shopping, Technik & mehr.

  • Empfehlungsprämie: Netzwerk teilen lohnt sich. Jede erfolgreiche Empfehlung wird belohnt.

  • Highlights: Mehrere Company- und Team-Events pro Jahr sorgen für Austausch, Spaß und ein echtes Wir-Gefühl.

  • Echte Verantwortung: Ownership ab Tag eins, flache Hierarchien und erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich Zeit für Dein Mentoring nehmen.

  • Echte Perspektive: Leistungsstarke Werkstudierende werden regelmäßig für Festanstellungen nach dem Abschluss berücksichtigt.


Gut zu wissen

  • Wie viele Stunden pro Woche? 20 Stunden im Semester, flexibel rund um Dein Studium geplant.

  • Wo ist der Job? In Berlin-Mitte im Mindspace Stadtmitte, mit hybridem Setup: Du arbeitest teils vor Ort, teils remote.

  • Muss ich Deutsch sprechen? Deutsch auf B1-Niveau reicht aus; unsere Arbeitssprache ist Englisch.

  • Brauche ich Berufserfahrung? Nein. Echtes Interesse an IT-Administration und Security plus solide macOS-Kenntnisse sind das, was zählt.

  • Kann daraus ein Vollzeitjob werden? Ja. Leistungsstarke Werkstudierende erhalten regelmäßig Festanstellungsangebote nach dem Abschluss.


Über Vivira


ViViRA. Simply move.


Vivira entwickelt digitale Gesundheitsversorgung mit echtem Impact. Unsere App ist Deutschlands erste dauerhaft gelistete Digitale Gesundheitsanwendung (DiGA) gegen Rückenschmerzen und offiziell im BfArM-Verzeichnis erstattungsfähiger Anwendungen gelistet. Jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt in Deutschland kann Vivira verordnen, die Kosten übernimmt vollständig die gesetzliche Krankenversicherung.


Wir sind ein internationales, schnell wachsendes Team mit Sitz in Berlin, vereint durch den Anspruch, Gesundheitsversorgung zugänglicher, wirksamer und menschlicher zu machen.


So bewirbst Du Dich


Schick uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben brauchst Du nicht. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei Dir. Der Prozess ist kurz: ein Kennenlern-Call, ein praxisnahes Gespräch mit dem Team und dann die Entscheidung.


Bewirb Dich jetzt und hilf mit, die IT am Laufen zu halten, die digitale Gesundheitsversorgung möglich macht.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce)
description:
Deine Mission

Alle reden über AI. Wir entscheiden, wie sie im Unternehmen wirklich eingesetzt wird.
Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team, das nicht primär Code schreibt, sondern entscheidet, was AI im Unternehmen bewirken soll - für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern, durch Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse.

Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce) in unserem Headquarter in München-Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, Business und AI - als Sparringspartner:in für AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie eine ehemalige BCG-Beraterin. Nicht als zusätzliche:r Engineer im Team, sondern als die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das Team das Richtige baut.
Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle für Techies. Du strukturierst Probleme, baust Business Cases, bewertest AI-Anwendungen aus Business-Perspektive und übersetzt zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was strategisch sinnvoll ist. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein.

Was du wirklich machst

  • AI-Strategie statt AI-Code: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice-File-Analyse) mit - nicht als Entwickler:in, sondern als jemand, der Anforderungen strukturiert, Prioritäten setzt und aus ersten Ideen belastbare Feature-Konzepte macht. Die technische Umsetzung übernehmen unsere AI Engineers; du sorgst dafür, dass sie das Richtige bauen.
  • Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, baust Business Cases nach klassischer Case-Logik auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden.
  • AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du definierst Kompetenzframeworks und Bewertungslogiken, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - die inhaltliche Logik, nicht die technische Implementierung.
  • Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Konzept - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben.
  • Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. Das bedeutet Abwechslung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und sichtbaren Impact.
Warum diese Rolle dich außergewöhnlich schnell wachsen lässt

Hier lernst du nicht programmieren - du lernst, wie man AI-Investitionen bewertet, Business Cases baut, die vor Geschäftsführung und Leadership bestehen, und komplexe Themen so strukturiert, dass daraus messbarer Business Impact entsteht. Genau das Handwerk, das du später in der Strategieberatung oder im Corporate Strategy-Umfeld brauchst - nur, dass die Empfehlung hier real umgesetzt wird und nicht in einer Präsentation endet.
Du arbeitest eng mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin sowie AI Engineers und Product-Expert:innen zusammen und bewegst dich täglich zwischen Strategie, Business Judgement und AI.
Die letzte Werkstudentin ist anschließend als Trainee bei uns eingestiegen - nicht, weil wir es versprechen, sondern weil sie während ihrer Zeit bei uns bereits Verantwortung übernommen hat.


Dein Skillset

  • Akademischer Hintergrund: Du studierst aktuell im Master (BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) und bringst bereits erste praktische Erfahrung mit - idealerweise mit strategischem oder analytischem Fokus.
  • AI-affin, kein AI Engineer: Du musst nicht coden können und keine Modelle bauen. Aber du nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT als Power-User für Recherche, Analyse und Strukturierung - und verstehst, wie AI Geschäftsprozesse verändert. Wichtiger als technisches Tiefenwissen: Du erkennst, welches Problem ein AI-Use-Case eigentlich lösen soll.
  • Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte sauber und nutzt PowerPoint und Excel sicher genug, um überzeugende Management-Präsentationen und Business Cases aufzubereiten.
  • Mindset: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt erklärt. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, denkst unternehmerisch und willst Lösungen entwickeln statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst und präsentierst in verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst natürlich über eine gesunde Portion Humor.
  • Rahmenbedingungen: Du hast 16–20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters Kapazität, bei uns vor Ort im Münchner Headquarter tätig zu sein. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit flexibel bis Vollzeit möglich.


Dein Winning Deal

  • Deine Chance: Vom ersten Tag an arbeitest du an einer der strategisch wichtigsten AI-Initiativen unseres Unternehmens mit und gestaltest Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag tausender Menschen verbessern können.
  • Dein Buddy: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin, die dich individuell begleitet und fordert.
  • Dein Netzwerk: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit AI Engineers, Product-, Strategy- und Operations-Expert:innen - Einblicke, die klassische Werkstudentenstellen selten bieten.
  • Deine Perspektive: Ein anschließender Einstieg als Trainee ist ausdrücklich möglich und in unserem Team bereits mehrfach Realität geworden. 
  • Deine Benefits:Neben weekly Pizza und Snacks vor Ort, bieten wir dir außerdem einen Joblunch-Zuschuss (4 x 6,90 € im Monat), eine bezuschusste Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits" sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents.
  • Dein Arbeitsplatz: Flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell in einem unserer modernen, hundefreundlichen Büros.
  • Dein Beitrag: Eine Position in einem profitablen Unternehmen, in dem du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen hast, mitzugestalten und mit uns an der „Future of Work" zu arbeiten.
  • Unsere Werte: Eine offene, authentische Kultur und ein leistungsstarkes, humorvolles Team, das sich darauf freut, gemeinsam mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen.

title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich.

Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. 

Deine Aufgaben
Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement

  • Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance.
  • Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre.
  • CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen.
  • Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern.
Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency
  • Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden.
  • Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks.
  • Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich.
  • FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung.


Dein Skillset

  • Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus.
  • Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt.
  • Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash.
  • Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS.
  • FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus.
  • Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor.


Dein Winning Deal

title: (Senior) Campaign Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Campaign Manager (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 

What Will Your Role Be

We're looking for a Senior Campaign Manager to own marketing campaign planning and execution across our entire D2C business. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role with direct exposure to senior leadership.

What You´ll Do 

Own the Campaign Calendar

  • Maintain a forward-looking campaign roadmap 8–12 weeks ahead, balancing MP-specific, CYO-specific, and D2C-wide initiatives 

 

Plan Campaigns End-to-End 

  • Write clear campaign briefs covering objectives, audience, channels, messaging, KPIs, and timelines 

  • Define the channel mix and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Paid Social, CRM, On-Page, and SEO teams to align on execution 

 

Drive Production 

  • Brief creative teams on asset needs - graphics, copy, landing pages, email templates - and manage the approval process 

  • Initiate and oversee campaign-related photo shoots from concept to delivery 

 

Deliver and Measure 

  • Hold accountability for on-time, on-brief campaign delivery across all channels 

  • Track campaign performance in real-time; run post-campaign analyses and share learnings 

  • Report results and strategic recommendations with visibility regularly to the Head of Marketplace and Head of CYO 

What You´ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in campaign management or integrated marketing, ideally in e-commerce or D2C 

  • A track record of running multi-channel campaigns with real revenue impact - you can show us the numbers 

  • Solid understanding of paid search, paid social, email marketing, SEO, and on-page levers 

  • Experience managing creative production, including briefing studios or agencies 

  • Highly organized with strong project management instincts - you keep complex workstreams on track 

  • A confident communicator who is comfortable presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders 

  • Data-literate: you use performance data to make decisions, not gut feeling alone 

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience in print-on-demand, customization, fashion, or lifestyle brands 

  • Hands-on with marketing automation tools (Klaviyo, SFMC, or similar) 

  • Working knowledge of GA4 and UTM-based campaign attribution 

  • You've managed a photo shoot before  

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status.

Sounds Like You? 

Send us your CV and a brief note on a campaign you're particularly proud of - what made it work, and what you'd do differently. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Teamleiter Brand Experience & Partnerships (Mensch)
FP&A Manager
description:
ABOUT PEEC AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with an 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About the role

We're looking for a FP&A Manager to join as the analytical backbone of our Finance team. This is a strategic finance role: you'll own the financial model, run forecasting cycles, define the KPI framework, and produce the dashboards and finance packs that leadership and the board use to steer the business. Working alongside the Head of Finance, you'll partner with commercial leads on budget ownership and spend decisions, support investor reporting and fundraising, and collaborate with our Business Systems Lead to shape the data infrastructure. You'll have a seat in strategy discussions and real influence over how we think about growth - if you've spent a few years in FP&A at a B2B SaaS company and want more ownership and impact, this is it.

What you’ll do

Modeling & Forecasting

  • Maintain and evolve the company’s financial model end to end: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and headcount plan

  • Run monthly and quarterly forecasting cycles, including reforecast vs. budget variance analysis

  • Build scenario and sensitivity analyses to support business decisions - revenue segmentation, cohort analysis, pricing, hiring, opex, international expansion

Reporting & KPIs

  • Own the KPI framework: define, track, and report on the metrics that matter across the business

  • Tie the financial model directly into business rhythm, monthly and quarterly goal steering with commercial leads

  • Build and maintain management dashboards in collaboration with the Business Systems team

Business Partnering

  • Partner with department heads on budget ownership, headcount tracking, and spend variance

  • Translate financial data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for non-finance stakeholders

description:

  • Mandantenbetreuung: Kompetente Ansprechperson für steuerliche Fragen und strategische Beratung

  • Du kommst in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase zu uns und hast echte Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Flache Hierarchien mit echtem Ownership

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: mobil im Inland, mit einem modernen Büro in Berlin, wann immer du möchtest

 

Das macht deinen Job aus

Du hast deinen Steuerberater-Titel frisch in der Tasche oder stehst kurz davor und fragst dich, wo du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst. Du willst aktiv mitgestalten, wie die steuerliche Arbeit der Zukunft aussieht, und siehst KI und Automatisierung nicht als Bedrohung, sondern als Chance. Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

  • Bestellte:r Steuerberater:in (oder kurz davor) mit Erfahrung in DATEV oder vergleichbaren Systemen

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst selbst mit an und scheust dich nicht vor operativen Aufgaben

  • Gestaltungswille: Du siehst in einer Gründungsphase eine Chance, Veränderung mitzugestalten

Was wir nicht suchen

  • Menschen, die Teamarbeit und kollegiale Unterstützung nicht wertschätzen

  • „Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht"-Mentalität

title: City Scout (UK)
description:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers across the UK.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

Hiring in: London.

 

The Job

  • Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

  • Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

  • Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

  • Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

  • Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

  • Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

  • Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

  • Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

  • Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

  • Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

  • A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

  • Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

  • Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

Senior Back-End Engineer - Ledger Platform

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Back-End Engineer

This role is a chance to tackle complex, high-impact challenges at the heart of our fintech platform. You will join the team that owns iwoca's ledger — the system of record for the money we lend and collect — and you will be responsible for scaling it across the full lifecycle of our credit card and lending products, building the reconciliation and reporting that prove it correct, and laying the foundations for our next generation of products. This is a hands-on role: you'll design these systems, write the code, and own them in production.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Ledger Platform team owns the ledger across all of iwoca's products, from credit cards to our lending range, plus everything around it: reconciliation, financial reporting, and the data Finance, Accounting and Capital Markets run on. We work closely with a Product Manager, shipping frequently and owning our systems in production. Some of the team work fully remotely and others are hybrid, working 1-3 days per week in the London office.


The role

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Lead the delivery of projects involving many stakeholders and systems.

  • Go beyond the code to develop deep expertise in our domain — our core financial products and our stakeholders' needs — and become a trusted technical advisor to the business.

  • Perform detailed technical scoping and prototyping to support feasibility testing and decision making.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Architect and implement scalable solutions for complex challenges: the lifecycle of an account, interest and repayment allocation, reconciliation, and how financial data reaches our reporting stack.

  • Use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem, and structure software so that it is easy to understand, test and evolve.

  • Be pragmatic about which parts of a problem actually need solving now. The hardest work here is deciding what not to build.

  • Build solutions that avoid single points of failure, and make sure our releases happen with zero downtime.

  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, actionable technical plans that guide the team's work.

  • Promptly investigate and fix live issues, and ensure they do not resurface. Own what you ship in production and keep it reliable and easy to operate.

  • Contribute high-quality, production-ready code and foster a collaborative environment by reviewing work and writing useful documentation.

Learning and Growth:

  • Work with the team to improve our development and agile practices and raise our engineering standards.

  • Share new approaches and tooling with the wider engineering group through our internal forums and company-wide talks.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Extensive back-end engineering experience.

  • Experience building and running microservices and distributed systems in production. Comfortable reasoning about durable cross-service communication, transactional correctness, and failure modes at scale.

  • Extensive experience with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, but open to MySQL or similar (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle); emphasis is on data integrity.

  • Experience with systems where correctness is a hard requirement — ledgers, accounting, billing or payments, ideally in a regulated setting — including the invariants, immutable audit trails and reconciliation controls that enforce it.

  • Experience leading a feature or project end to end — scoping, design, delivery, and running it in production.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow - whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • A strong technical or mathematical foundation, evidenced by a degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Maths or similar) or equivalent professional experience.

  • You work well as a peer: pairing on hard problems, giving useful code review, and unblocking teammates day-to-day.

  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a technical trade-off to Finance, and a business constraint back to engineers.

Bonus:

  • A background in high-logic or high-scale fields like Fintech, Gaming, Healthcare Tech, Logistics, Security/Cryptography or similar.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

  • Knowledge of messaging frameworks and event-driven patterns (e.g. Kafka).

The salary

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across:

  • Customer Support

  • Customer Onboarding

  • Sales and Account Management

  • Product and Product Operations

  • Revenue Operations

  • Finance

  • Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.

  • Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.

  • Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.

  • Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.

  • Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions

Why is this role a good fit for you?

  • You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

  • Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts.

  • Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals.

  • Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers.

In your first 5 months, you’ll:

  • Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers.

title: Senior Application Security Manager
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Application Security Manager to join our Cybersecurity team at Pleo. In this role, you'll own vulnerability management and set the long-term application security strategy, turning a growing stream of signal into a risk-ranked plan the engineering organisation can actually act on. If you're a player-coach who wants high leverage with low bureaucracy, and you'd rather mature a program than maintain one, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our VP of Fraud & Security and lead a small AppSec team with dotted lines to other security members. Your primary customers are Pleo's engineering squads, and your closest partners are DevSecOps, who feed you signal and automation, alongside SecOps, Risk & Compliance, Privacy, and Legal. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to keeping Pleo and its customers safe. You'll also have the chance to shape how the wider organisation thinks about security, well beyond your own team.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Application Security Manager, you will:

  • Own vulnerability management end to end, covering reporting, triage, mitigation, and the long-term strategy for application security as a department.

  • Build a structured, risk-ranked approach to remediation, so the organisation knows what to fix first and why.

  • Establish clear, company-wide reporting on our vulnerability posture, giving leadership the data-driven visibility they need.

  • Set and deliver an AppSec roadmap, bringing delivery expectations and accountability to a team that hasn't had them.

  • Partner with engineering squads as customers rather than gatekeeping them, embedding proactive security processes into how they already work.

  • Multiply your team's impact through automation and AI, so coverage scales faster than headcount.

  • Grow and mentor engineers, coaching them toward staff-level capability and building their confidence along the way.

  • Support Pleo's compliance obligations across ISO27001, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and the regulatory expectations of each market we operate in, from a security vulnerability perspective.

  • Reduce our attack surface through technical controls, policy, and AI enablement, addressing both external threats and internal risk.

  • Contribute to the broader Cybersecurity team, staying connected with ongoing initiatives and helping shape our 2027 KPIs.

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience steering application security and wider information security strategy in a compliance-heavy environment.

  • A background as a senior security engineer who moved into management, with enough technical depth that you're still credible and still hands-on.

  • A track record of mentoring and growing engineers, and of keeping a team accountable without micromanaging it.

  • Demonstrated experience turning signal into prioritised action through risk-based triage.

  • Experience using AI and automation to scale security coverage, rather than solving everything through headcount or process.

  • The ability to shape culture outside your own team, influencing engineering squads without formal authority over them.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, complex, ever-evolving environment, where you're self-directed and proactive.

  • Exposure to fintech compliance requirements is a strong advantage. Backgrounds we also look at include DevSecOps and platform security leads with real AppSec depth.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want a fast, visible impact on a program with real room to improve, without having to fight for basic tooling and process first.

  • You treat developers as customers and get satisfaction from security becoming an enabler rather than a blocker.

  • You like being a player-coach, staying close to the technical work while growing the people around you.

  • You're motivated by high leverage and low bureaucracy, and you'd rather build the system than personally do every task.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You're looking to step away from technical work entirely at this level.

  • You prefer to lead through mandate and process rather than partnership and example.

  • You're sceptical of automation, AI, or of leaning on signal from partner teams.

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Get hands-on with Pleo's application security landscape, understanding our attack surface across payment systems and multi-region infrastructure, and forming your own view of where the real risk sits.

  • Stand up clear vulnerability reporting and a risk-ranked remediation approach, and get key vulnerabilities patched proactively ahead of our next compliance audit.

  • Build trust with engineering squads and start shifting the security culture, so teams come to you early rather than late.

  • Integrate into the Cybersecurity team, connecting with DevSecOps, SecOps, and Risk & Compliance, and begin shaping the roadmap and KPIs that carry the program into 2027.

By 12 months, the goal is a documented, repeatable security program with proactive threat monitoring in place, regulatory readiness for new markets, and a team that can scale.

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into broader leadership, or acquiring new skills.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25-28 days of holiday (depending on your location) + public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role, your background, and how you feel about the player-coach shape of the job.

  2. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute conversation with our security management team, covering your AppSec depth, your evidence of maturing an existing program, and your partnership mindset.

  3. Technical interview: a 60-minute deep dive with our AppSec team on your hands-on application security expertise.

  4. Cross-functional interview: a 30-45 minute conversation with Privacy, Legal, and Risk & Compliance on how you work across those boundaries.

  5. Leadership interview: a 45-minute conversation on mentoring and growing engineers, and influencing without authority.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.
